Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. The effect only targets 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
Card Q&A.q: I have 2 Digimon in play. Can I use this card's [All Turns] effect to give -2000 DP each to 2 of my opponent's Digimon?

Effect: [When Digivolving] If a card with [Monzaemon] in its name or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, you may play 1 [Numemon] or level 3 Digimon card from your hand without paying the cost.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When one of your other Digimon is played, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -2000 DP for each of your Digimon until the end of their turn.
Special Digivolution Condition: [Digivolve] Lv.5 w/[Monzaemon] in name w/o [X Antibody] trait: Cost 0
